ddr-reise.specific_finding: The summary says there are no direct jumps between non-connected cities. The complete German Spielablauf reference instead requires a red event card whenever a player reaches one of their own destinations; its named city is where the pawn must now be placed, and the journey continues from there. The unrestricted no-jumps statement removes a central mandatory relocation procedure. Specific MAJOR for this covered movement/event rule only; the source is a third-party gameplay reference with full original setup and movement exceptions still missing. No complete audit or body repair.

guerilla.evidence: Actual HTTP 200 complete plain-text Grognard errata1/guer2.txt retrieved and read in full. Current Grognard G index explicitly lists separate Avalon Hill and Maplay games and offers this file for Maplay. The Q&A uses Indonesian supply boats and guerilla villages, matching the named 1974 Maplay Malaysia/Indonesia game BGG 7027 and local description, despite local publisher misattribution. Not the unrelated Avalon Hill rebel/government card game. Accurate rules_reference_text, no official publisher authorship or original date established. Full operative Q&A/notes selected with contributor attribution and original file retained unchanged. Supply assessed at turn start cannot be restored for combat that turn; entering a hostile-occupied hex requires stopping/combat; boats guarded by co-located friendly combat units; no helicopter roping into hostile hexes; supply transport cannot simultaneously carry combat units; villages can be raided repeatedly; Indonesian supply boats start in Indonesia and need combat-unit crews; conditional two-hex road/truck resupply; decoy and individually stacked units each need supply counters with no transfer; clear/road movement bonus capped at two hexes, with road-side crossing restriction and example. Complete base setup, basic allowances, CRT/combat and victory remain missing. One unchanged index component preserves identity provenance. No specific MAJOR established in this scoped pass: the local adjacent-combat wording is suspect but the Q&A alone does not fully define all combat eligibility. Unverified, no complete audit, PASS or body repair.
